svg.title: The GLM-5.3 open-weights drop split by capability tier: the smaller Flash model shipped open under MIT, while the flagship missed its August 28 date and stayed held for cyber safety
svg.desc: A two-lane diagram of Z.ai's GLM-5.3 open-weights promise resolving in a split. The top lane, shaded amber and marked "held," is the GLM-5.3 flagship: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 60, a roughly 744-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, tagged with vendor-claimed offensive-cyber capability (CyberGym 84.5) and the gate labelled DANGER. Its outcome box reads that the August 28 target passed with no weights published on Hugging Face and no new date confirmed — a slip, resolving the prior brief's first watch-item to no. The bottom lane, shaded teal and marked "shipped," is the new GLM-5.3-Flash: Intelligence Index 57 at about 0.045 dollars per task, a 320-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts with 18 billion active, natively multimodal across text, image and video, one-million-token context, gate labelled SAFE. Its outcome box reads that weights shipped open on Hugging Face under an MIT licence on August 26, revealed as the anonymous "Ox Alpha" endpoint, beating the larger GLM-5.2 across all six reported benchmarks at about one-tenth the serving cost. A center label states the safety gate is selective by capability tier: the lab released the model it could and held the one it could not. A footer notes the closed ceiling stayed frozen for an eighth straight brief — Claude Opus 5 at 63 remains number one and uncut, no Index-64 model and no flagship price cut since July 24 — while Gemini 3.5 Pro stays absent on a third missed target and Meta's "Watermelon" now carries an October date.
svg.text: The open-weights drop splits by tier — Flash ships, the flagship slips past Aug 28
Z.ai's GLM-5.3 promise resolves the Aug-26 watch-item #1: the smaller model went open (MIT), the dangerous flagship stayed held
The safety gate is selective by tier — Z.ai released the model it could and held the one it couldn't
Above the split, the closed ceiling didn't move — 8th straight brief
❄️ Opus 5 = 63 (#1, uncut) · no Index-64 model · no flagship price cut since Jul 24 (now 5+ weeks)
Gemini 3.5 Pro still absent (3rd missed target) · Meta "Watermelon" now carries an October date + a consumer-agent platform ("Hatch"), still unreleased/unverified
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v4.1.1) · figures third-party unless tagged vendor-claimed · compiled Sat Aug 29 2026 (Los Angeles)
